title: 菊花賞の後に・本走にして助走

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We knew we couldn't win… Yet despite everyone around us saying it was too soon, Tamamo Cross still chose to run.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Yeah, I knew it was too high a hurdle. I knew it… but guess what? I still ran the whole 3,000 meters!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I got the full experience… with my own eyes and my own legs. The hills, the curves, the last stretch… every hurdle the course could throw at me.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Which means… I'm ready for next year! All right!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's so ecstatic about her result, it's easy to forget that we only entered on a whim. It's clear she had her own reasons for running.
choice_data_list: Why did you really want to join this race?
Why did you really want to join this race?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, that's personal. Ya know how it is, I got certain circumstances. But I guess I could tell ya…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Okay, time for a pop quiz! When it comes to long-distance G1 races in Kyoto, there's the Kikuka Sho aaand… Fill in the blank!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I give it a think. The example that comes to mind is…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ding-ding. Some say that the spring Tenno Sho is the best race out there.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And my dad's one of 'em!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Haha, ya could say he's obsessed. But when a race's got so much history, you're bound to get some fanatics.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But in any case, that's my goal. I want him to see his little girl runnin' in his favorite race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: That's why I took the risk 'n ran this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross grins through her exhaustion. It looks like this race was actually a form of preparation, planned with her family in mind.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Tamamo…

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You put up one heck of a fight… Hard to believe it's over, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey there, City. Same goes for you. Thanks to you, this ended up bein' a pretty good year.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Our talk about food before the Classic Triple Crown really changed the way I thought about stuff.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: You're the reason I'm standin' here today. Thanks a lot.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I'm just as grateful for you… Your resilience gave me the courage to push on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Even when we weren't running together, I still felt like we were in the same race. That feeling never went away…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Really? Well, I guess that's the perk of competin' in the same year. We get each other on a whole 'nother level from our juniors or seniors.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And ya know, I got loads of pals 'n rivals now… but I'm real glad you're one of them!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having reached the end of the Classic Triple Crown, the two set off on their respective journeys. Only time will tell what their senior years will bring.
